value.name: Asha lowers her voice
value.description: Asha speaks quietly so her words will not carry beyond the doorway, signaling the conversation must stay private.
evidence: her voice until it would not carry past the doorframe behind her.

value.name: Asha asks who knows staffing dropped
value.description: Asha asks Lucia who else is aware that staffing has fallen, probing how widely the problem has spread.
evidence: She asked who else knew the staffing had dropped

value.name: Lucia reveals separate facility list
value.description: Instead of answering directly, Lucia produces a second, shorter list of facilities she has been keeping separate from the report.
evidence: Lucia, instead of answering, reached back into her bag and drew out a second, shorter list, three or four facilities printed on a half page

value.name: Lucia offers the list shakily
value.description: Lucia's shaking hand holds out the folded list to Asha, showing her hesitation and urgency.
evidence: Her hand shook as she held it out

value.name: Asha accepts Lucia's hidden list
value.description: Asha takes the separately carried list without looking at the names yet, recognizing Lucia had not fully decided to reveal it.
evidence: Asha took it without looking at the names yet
she could see that Lucia had been carrying this one separately, not stapled to the report, the way a person carries something they have not yet decided to show

value.name: Asha realizes Lucia already called facilities
value.description: Seeing the top entry on the list, Asha understands Lucia has already made the calls and learned which places still have beds.
evidence: she understood that Lucia had already done the calling, already heard which ones had beds

value.name: Asha keeps the list for immediate use
value.description: Asha folds the page again and keeps it in her hand, signaling she intends to act on it before morning.
evidence: She folded the page once more along its existing crease and kept it in her hand rather than putting it away
so that Lucia could see she meant to use it before morning

value.name: Asha displays the list back to Lucia
value.description: Asha unfolds the list and holds it up so Lucia can see the facility names, pressing her for specifics.
evidence: Asha unfolded the half-page the rest of the way against her palm and held it where Lucia could see it too, the four names sitting in the corridor light.

value.name: Asha asks which facility answered
value.description: Asha asks Lucia which of the listed facilities gave her a real answer, seeking the most reliable option.
evidence: She asked which of them had given Lucia a real answer.

value.name: Lucia confirms Wynnewood respite bed
value.description: Lucia steps closer and says the Wynnewood facility has a respite bed open through Sunday and that someone there actually called her back.
evidence: Lucia took a small step closer
she said the Wynnewood place had a respite bed open through Sunday and the woman on the phone had actually called her back
